# Ricky Kashyap

> DevOps engineer and embedded systems developer from Guwahati, Assam, India.
> B.Tech Computer Science, Gauhati University (2023–2027).
> Currently DevOps Engineer (Intern) at VrixaaLabs Pvt Ltd.

## Who

Ricky Kashyap works where hardware meets infrastructure: firmware for ESP32 and
RP2040 microcontrollers on one side, production web deployment and self-hosted
infrastructure on the other. He runs a homelab (Proxmox hypervisor, pfSense
gateway with VLANs, Docker workloads, Grafana monitoring, Cloudflare Tunnel
ingress) that auto-deploys on git push.

## Projects

- RoadSense — crowd-sourced road-hazard mapping for Indian cities. ESP32
  vehicle nodes + Kotlin Android app report potholes to a live Mapbox heatmap
  on Cloudflare Pages/Functions/D1. https://github.com/priencelucifer/Roadsense
- Guwahati Water Department — deployed a private internal platform (pin board
  and messaging tool) for the department; hosting and access setup.
- Creativlok — end-to-end production deployment of a live e-commerce
  storefront: hosting, DNS, SSL, go-live, post-launch updates.
- Corne BLE Keyboard — handwired wireless split mechanical keyboard; ESP32
  BLE HID firmware in C++, deep-sleep power management, 3D-printed case.
  https://github.com/priencelucifer/esp32_corne_ble_keyboard
- Pico Web HID Controller — Raspberry Pi Pico as a browser-controlled
  keyboard/mouse/macro device over Wi-Fi (CircuitPython).
  https://github.com/priencelucifer/Pi-Pico-Web-Based-HID-Controller
- Low-cost Agri IoT Sensors — environmental/soil sensor node under Rs. 2000
  (C++/ESP32).
  https://github.com/priencelucifer/Low-cost-IoT-sensors-for-agriculture-and-environmental-monitoring.
- Pico Zero Security Key — hardware security key on the Pi Pico (CCID via
  pico-keys-sdk). https://github.com/priencelucifer/pico-keys-sdk
- NotesHub — peer-to-peer, privacy-first, account-free platform for sharing
  campus notes and past papers. https://github.com/priencelucifer/noteshub-public
